verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirmed a downloadable OpenAPI document at https://supabase.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). First-party docs also describe the programmatic Management API, type-safe API definitions generated by database introspection, and a GraphQL API reflected from the schema, all of which are machine-readable equivalents. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the OpenAPI file's scope and how to download it, clarity on whether it covers the Management API or per-project REST endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of its completeness.
